name: Bookkeeping, accounting and auditing clerks
oneLiner: Rule-based verification of numbers, at high volume, in a digitised system.
why: Reconciliation is pattern matching against rules the machine already holds
High volume and routine, so savings per hour are large

claims.text: Employers expect a sharp fall in accounting and auditing clerk roles to 2030, alongside cashiers, ticket clerks and administrative assistants.
Accounting and bookkeeping clerks sit in the ILO's highest generative-AI exposure gradient.
The ILO finds strongly digitised occupations have increased in exposure as models gained multimodal and agentic capability.
